The Codex guide

Why cloud and DevOps are a game-changer for an SME

01DevOps means automating everything between writing code and putting it online: tests, builds, deployment and monitoring. The result: frequent updates without downtime, and the ability to roll back in minutes.

02The cloud lets resources follow real usage. Rather than paying for an oversized server all year round, the infrastructure adjusts to activity peaks, for example during Ramadan or the sales.

03We choose with you between hosting in France and an international cloud according to your data, latency and budget constraints, and we document every element so your team stays in control.

  1. 01

    Discovery

FAQ

Cloud & DevOps: your questions

Another question? Write to us, we reply quickly.

Can you host our data in France?

Yes. Depending on your regulatory constraints, we deploy with Francen or international hosting providers and advise you on the best trade-off.

What does DevOps bring to an SME?

More frequent, stress-free releases, fewer outages, and the ability to roll back in minutes if something goes wrong.

Do you offer managed services?

Yes, we can run your infrastructure day to day: updates, security, backups and monitoring.
